==Description==
The '''Rusted''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] with an average speed and more health than the [[Chained Boss|Chained]]. Though it was not considered a boss, it had high health for its debut. This could be considered a tougher variation of the [[Golden]] as it had much higher health. However, the '''Rusted''' was not immune to splash damage.

==Appearance==
The '''Rusted''' was made entirely out of corroded metal. It had brown skin and a brown wristband on its left arm. Its torso and legs were black. Metal protrusions could be seen just above its waist on the bottom left side of its torso. It was about the same size as the [[Golden]].

==Strategy==
*The '''Rusted''' does not spawn in large hordes, so high DPS towers, such as the [[Turret]] and the [[Minigunner]], can easily defeat this enemy.
*Due to '''Rusteds''' spawning very unfrequently, they are not much of a threat.
*Unlike [[Golden]]s, the '''Rusted''' is not immune to explosions.
**The '''Rusted''' is not immune to anything, unlike other enemies that spawn alongside it.
**This means that the [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] can easily wipe them out.
